name: Goshujin-samania
source:
Seven years ago, her father died. 
One year ago today, she lost her mother. 
Mitsuki faked an illness to sabotage the memorial service. 
She dumped all responsibility on her younger brother Yuki 
and sought an accomplice to fulfill her destructive desire. 

Online, she met a man who called himself Asami. 
As they fornicated in sadomasochistically 
she frantically tried to escape... something. Her constantly tortured self. 

A father dead from unknown causes. 
A mother dead from disease. 
A cold and distant brother. 
A man obsessed with her. 

Mitsuki's world spins wildly on the axis where all characters meet. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE160175.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
七年前，她的父亲去世。
一年前的今天，她失去了母亲。
美月装病，破坏了纪念仪式。
她把所有责任推给弟弟优希，
并寻找共犯，实现毁灭欲望。

她在网上遇见一个自称浅见的男人。
两人进行SM式性交时，
她拼命试图逃离……某个不断折磨着她的自己。

父亲死因不明。
母亲死于疾病。
冷漠疏远的弟弟。
痴迷于她的男人。

美月的世界围绕所有角色交汇的轴心疯狂旋转。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE160175.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
